notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.2.0
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

Fixed ledge snap getting triggered when not needed, which now results in a much more fluid movement feeling during platforming. It should now be triggered when its actually needed to reach a platform / ledge

Fixed wall collider to prevent wall jumps on it that leads to exiting level bounds in flower platform section of the demo

Graphics:

Improved performance by implementing a multi-threaded graphics render commands pipeline that reduces CPU load on the main thread

Implemented ability to change display resolution in addition to upscaling options (DLSS, FSR, and STP)

Added option to set maximum FPS to limit FPS to a custom choice (can be useful to preserve battery life on a notebook)

Improved graphics performance by reducing graphics memory usage of several GB without a loss of visual fidelity 

UI:

Added loading spinner for warm up screen to indicate the game is working on compiling the shaders

Audio:

Added UI volume slider to adjust user interface (UI) related audio loudness

Expanded audio volume sliders to go to 150% loudness from previous maximum 100% to allow for more personalized options as well as improving accessibility for users that require it

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.1.0
notes.notes:
Graphics:

Fixed majority of DX12 shader stutter by introducing a shader compilation step when the game is started. Not all shaders can be pre warmed as of now due to a limitation by the used game engine (Unity)

UI:

Corrected gamepad prompt icons for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller to be shown correctly for gameplay prompts

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.0.1
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

Checkpoints restore all of player's life

Added wall jump blocker to level segment (first key pick-up area) to limit wall jumps that visuals match with level boundaries

Graphics:

Implemented a check if the game is running on a Steam Deck and uses new recommended default values that enables FSR2 upscaling by default

Removed Depth of Field (DoF) effect in the foreground of the player and it is only used in the background now

Improved performance by optimizing water rendering settings

Updated Unity STP upscaler to have the same rendering injection point as DLSS and FSR to ensure same upscaling behavior

UI:

Fixed start buttons not being tinted and thus indicating focus is set on them for the game start screen as well as demo start screen

Added slope slide down controls hint to make sure players know how to accelerate and slow down while on slopes

Speed up of dialog text characters appearing in dialogs with NPCs

Preparations for control rebindings functionality by introducing a new controls sub tab menu UI setup

Audio:

Fixed SFX volume slider in audio settings having no effect and it now correctly lowers sound effects loudness
